_why: A rule in this bundle does not gain authority by being here. This says where each came from and who may override it.

classes.SOURCE-AUTHORITATIVE: What the text says. Changes only with new evidence.
classes.EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE: A decision about what we claim or how we attribute. Changes only by an editor.
classes.CREATIVE-PROPOSAL: A default the studio may override unless the user has approved it.
classes.PRODUCTION-LOCAL: Belongs to the studio. Carried here for convenience only.

files.source_register.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE — a rights BASIS, legal review recommended
files.traditions.json: SOURCE-AUTHORITATIVE for what each telling says; EDITORIAL for how it is handled
files.films.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for questions, answers and claims; CREATIVE-PROPOSAL for boundaries
files.treatments/*: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL — direction. Claims inside them are SOURCE; everything else can be redirected.
files.entities.json: mixed — T fields SOURCE, Tr fields SOURCE-for-that-telling, I and S fields CREATIVE-PROPOSAL
files.material_world.json: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL grounded in the material record
files.app_design.json: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL — the experience layer; the studio owns it
files.coverage_audit.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE — what the covered range contains and what we omit
files.episodes.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for the arc map; titles beyond M1–M10 are placeholders, not decisions
files.evidence_libraries.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE — what an inference may cite
files.forensic_changelog.json: HISTORY — never read as current truth. claims.json and the other records are current.
files.incidents.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for which events connect; CREATIVE-PROPOSAL for their framing
files.kandas.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for the arc map; sarga counts are NOT asserted
files.render_policy.json: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL — generation defaults; defers to seed_policy and LOCK.SKIN.POLICY
files.rhythm_policy.json: CREATIVE-PROPOSAL — advisory house style, never a gate
files.semantics.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for what a field MEANS; never for whether it is mandatory (authority.json decides)
files.threads.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE; the disclosure rule is mandatory
files.narration (treatments[].narration): EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE for wording and speaker; generated from data/narration_units.py
files.authority.json: EDITORIAL-AUTHORITATIVE — classifies every file and sets precedence (level 2)

precedence._rule: When two files control the same behaviour, the higher entry wins. No file may silently override a higher one.
order: 1 · claims.json, memos.json, scope.json, rights_policy.json — what is true, gated, audited and permitted
4 · seed_policy.json, rhythm_policy.json, LOCK.SKIN.POLICY — the specific policy for their concept
7 · grade, music, typography, transitions, effects, staging, material_world — creative proposals
